acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new endpoints are documented in the GUI API surface with request/response shapes.
StoreListItem interface in the MCP server API surface shows all five new fields.
reloadStoreContext() is listed as an export from store-context.ts.
api-stores.ts and config-stores.js appear in their respective file tree documents.
Store Management data flow (§11) describes the frontend → API → config write → context reload → response → re-render cycle.
Hot-reload constraint is documented in the GUI constraints document.

summary: Updated 7 manifest documents to reflect the GUI Store Management feature.

mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: Updated StoreListItem to show all 5 new fields; renamed handleGetStores to handleGetStoresEnriched; documented 6 new CRUD handlers (handleAddStore, handleImportStore, handleUpdateStore, handleRemoveStore, handleSetDefaultStore, handleReorderStores); added reloadStoreContext() to store-context.ts exports; updated server.ts route table with full Section A/B split.
mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: Added §1.8 Stores section (endpoints, StoreListItem interface, validation rules, response shapes).
mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/file-tree.md: Added api-stores.ts backend entry and config-stores.js frontend entry; updated size table row for config-stores.js.

mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md: Added §13 Store Management Data Flow (frontend → API → config write → context reload → response → re-render cycle with immediate-write invariants).

mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md: Renumbered §16 Known Limitations to §17; added new §16 Hot-Reload After Store Config Writes documenting the reloadStoreContext() contract, skipDirCreate purpose, and test isolation note.
mcp-server/gui/docs/agents/project-manifest/ui-components.md: Added §11b Stores Tab Classes (cs-default-star, cs-type-badge, cs-sync-badge, cs-path-cell, cs-copy-btn, cs-git-status).

Note: The Store Management data flow is §13 (not §11 as stated in the AC) because the document has grown since the WP was written — the AC text references a section number that predates other sections added between §11 and the current end of file.

comments.note: constraints.md §16 'Known Limitations' table had 'No hot reload' listing frontend-only (browser refresh). Renamed to 'No hot reload (frontend)' for clarity since the backend now has hot-reload via reloadStoreContext() — distinguishes the two contexts.

Store Management data flow landed as §13 rather than §11 due to document growth since WP was authored. The AC criterion text references §11 — marked met because the intent (data flow exists and describes the full cycle) is satisfied.
